tools.name: groundtruth_scoreboard
tools.description: Return the public accuracy scoreboard: how many forward calls GROUNDTRUTH has made, how many have resolved, and how those resolved. Use this to judge how much weight to give the other tools.

tools.name: groundtruth_census_figures
tools.description: Return the corpus-level figures the site publishes: launches captured per chain, how many resolved, and the share that rugged, died, survived or graduated, with the generation timestamp. tools.description: How fast coins in a given risk band actually rugged: median seconds from GROUNDTRUTH first seeing the curve to the rug, with p25 and p75, for one chain, band and window. tools.description: What $100 would have done across a creator's last N resolved launches. tools.name: groundtruth_seal_call
tools.description: Seal a verdict BEFORE the outcome exists, so it can be scored later. This is the honesty mechanism: the row is hash-chained to the previous one under your API key, so a verdict cannot be edited or removed after the coin resolves. tools.name: groundtruth_scorecard
tools.description: How often calls sealed under this API key were right. Groups them by band and by what the coin actually did, resolved from the same record the card reads. A call whose coin has not resolved counts as PENDING, never as a win -- report pending alongside resolved, because the denominator is the point.

tools.name: groundtruth_autopsy_index
tools.description: List the dated autopsies GROUNDTRUTH has published. Each is a writeup of one launch and what happened to it. Returns the available days; fetch a specific one from the public site at /autopsy/<day>.
